summary: Synthetic controlled race reproduced the source-inspected TeacherProfile.createProfile stale-route overwrite: after navigating to Demo Jordan, successful create completion leaves route.profileId=demo-jordan but renders the newly created authenticated teacher's local-overlay profile. Denied completion preserves Jordan. Own-profile and captured-read-only controls passed.

runtime_evidence.reachability: The fixture-provider wrapper held the exact TeacherProfile.createProfile runtime invocation after dispatch; synthetic registration, approval, login, and profile-create reached the held call. Three independent runs covered Jordan success, Jordan denied failure, and captured Sarah reference success while the create call was pending.
runtime_evidence.success: Before release rendered Demo Jordan (demo-seed-jordan). After success, URL/controller route remained demo-jordan while renderPublicSite projected Success Creator (demo-teacher-1, source local-overlay); fixture runtime ownProfile also belonged to demo-teacher-1.
runtime_evidence.failure: Injected fixture-only denied response returned errorCode=denied; route and rendered profile remained Demo Jordan (demo-seed-jordan).
runtime_evidence.capturedReferenceRace: While create was held, rendered captured route showed Sarah Endsley. After success, route.profileId remained reference-sarah but rendered projection became Success Creator and journey.profile source became local-overlay for demo-teacher-1. A subsequent public:profile-edit dispatch succeeded and changed the local overlay name to Unauthorized during completion; it did not return read_only_reference. This is local fixture state only, but falsifies preservation of captured-route projection/authority in this interleaving.
runtime_evidence.positive_control: Normal own-profile and own-public-profile render both showed Positive Control Owner.
runtime_evidence.authority_control: Authenticated synthetic account opening captured reference showed Sarah Endsley with source captured-readonly; profile-edit dispatch was denied with read_only_reference and reference display remained unchanged.
runtime_evidence.scope: Volatile in-memory fixture provider and synthetic identities only; no production authority, network, real teacher, persistent backend, or provider operation. Render tree/source assertions only, not visual QA.

root_cause_boundary: The async createProfile branch at public-controller.mjs around lines 729-758 invokes service(), whose completion syncs runtime and then unconditionally writes the created profile into journey.profile; no route-epoch guard protects the post-service profile projection writes. It is reachable and overwrites another teacher's public projection while route.profileId remains demo-jordan. On captured reference, successful completion also replaces the read-only journey projection; after that, public:profile-edit succeeds against the synthetic owner overlay while route.profileId remains reference-sarah. Failure completion does not install the overlay. No fix was attempted.
falsifier: Success completion would have been falsified if, after navigating to another profile while held, release retained that profile's rendered projection and captured-reference authority. It did not: Jordan became Success Creator; captured Sarah became Success Creator and then allowed a local edit. Denied failure retained Jordan. Independent normal own-profile and captured-readonly controls passed.
